title: MEDIC: TOWARDS A COMPREHENSIVE FRAMEWORK FOR EVALUATING LLMS IN CLINICAL APPLICATIONS
reasoning: The paper includes 'Ethical & bias concerns' as one of the five core dimensions of its MEDIC evaluation framework. It evaluates LLMs on their adherence to the American Medical Association (AMA) principles of medical ethics using specific datasets like med-safety and includes detailed scoring rubrics for 'Safety & Ethical Considerations'.
